---
title: 'Minimal and Bento Layouts'
description: 'Current minimal_luxe and bento_grid presets'
---

| Preset ID      | Initial composition                                                         | Base styling                                                          |
| :------------- | :-------------------------------------------------------------------------- | :-------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `minimal_luxe` | Header, bio, tech stack, repositories, social media, footer.                | Inter Tight, `#080808` background, `#f3f4f6` accent, 8-pixel radius.  |
| `bento_grid`   | Header, avatar, bio, tech stack, GitHub Readme Stats, Streak Stats, footer. | Inter Tight, `#09090b` background, `#a1a1aa` accent, 12-pixel radius. |

These are the actual preset IDs. `minimal` and `bento` are decoration-style names, not the IDs passed to `createConfiguration`.

Bento's external stats cards introduce upstream dependencies during publication. For a layout based only on GitHub data fetched by GitAscii, replace them with native stats widgets. See [external widgets](/widgets/external-widgets) and the [template catalog](/templates/overview).
